article.summary_es: International Pentecostal Church es una despensa de alimentos en Washington Heights, Manhattan, que aparece en el mapa Food Help NYC de la ciudad.
article.summary_en: International Pentecostal Church is a food pantry in Washington Heights, Manhattan, listed on the City's Food Help NYC map.
how_they_help_es: Es una despensa de alimentos según el mapa Food Help NYC.
Está ubicada en 619 W 179th St, Nueva York, NY 10033.
Abre los martes de 11:30am a 3:30pm y los viernes de 12pm a 3pm.
La lista no indica qué alimentos entrega ni si hay requisitos.
how_they_help_en: It is a food pantry listed on the City's Food Help NYC map.
It is located at 619 W 179th St, New York, NY 10033.
It is open Tuesdays 11:30am-3:30pm and Fridays 12pm-3pm.
The listing does not say what food is given or if there are requirements.
visit_tips_es: Horario de despensa: martes de 11:30am a 3:30pm y viernes de 12pm a 3pm.
Llame al (212) 568-3531 antes de ir para confirmar el horario.
Pregunte por teléfono qué alimentos ofrecen y qué necesita traer.
visit_tips_en: Call (212) 568-3531 before going to confirm the schedule.
Ask by phone what food they offer and what you need to bring.
